entries.f9b1f3b7163b8fd2: Under its mission of “Making the World More Interesting Through ‘Memory’,” the company states that it has a broad product portfolio with access to high-growth markets and will continue building strong relationships with key customers in each application. In SSD & Storage, the company will work to secure share mainly among major data center and enterprise customers in the medium term, and aims to gain a higher share of the SSD market in the long term. Regarding the long-term financial model formulated in November 2024, it is reported that, because performance has grown significantly above it, the model was replaced with a new one at the Investor Day on June 2, 2026.
